g.text: Enterprise Entity-Relationship Database Schema, Administrative Governance Tiers & Ingestion Lifecycles
Provisions tenant organizations, assigns codes & custom subdomains (acme, corp).
Purges child bookings, rooms, desks, sections, floors, buildings, branches & users.
Protected Guard: SYSTEM root organization is strictly immutable & undeletable.
Centralized audit trail tracking all tenant registration, deletion, and auth events.
Sheet 1: Org ➔ Sheet 2: Branches ➔ Sheet 3: Buildings ➔ Sheet 4: Floors ➔ Sheet 5: Sections
Org Admins can re-download & update populated sheets for 72h. Permanently locks after 72h.
Assigns Branch Admins with defaultBranchAdminPassword. Architectural view (No Desk Booking).
Strictly manages desks, reservations, pods, meeting rooms, and staff in assigned branch.
Col A: Full Name | Col B: =IF(ISBLANK(A2), "", ...) Email | Col C: =IF(ISBLANK(A2), "", ...) Temp Pwd
Config Sheet: Navy #1F4E79 • Ghost rows prevented • Upsert keyed on (orgId, email)
• Default Password Hub & Branch Audit Log Console:
Rule: ORG_ADMIN forbidden from booking desks
Floor Plan: Rendered in 4-Desk Facing Pods
Condition: Enabled only if Sheet 5 has "Yes"
Feature Highlight (72h Grace, Default Password Hub, Formula Automation)
Every entity carries an organizationId foreign key. All Prisma queries are scoped by the active tenant subdomain.
Branch Admins possess authority restricted to their scopedBranchId. Floor plan selectors, roster batch ingestion, and audit logs auto-scope to their branch.
Generated for Multi-Tenant Offline-First Desk Booking Platform • v2.5 Enterprise Edition
